# hivenet_regions (Data Source)

Lists the region codes the API accepts, e.g. `FR`. Use one as the `region` filter of `hivenet_presets`. A region being listed does not mean it has capacity; `hivenet_presets` shows what can be launched.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hivenet_regions" "all" {}

output "regions" {
  value = data.hivenet_regions.all.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Region codes.
